name: CoreWeave Forge
description: Track OpenClaw agent sessions in CoreWeave Forge for observability and debugging.

entity.description: W&B team or username slug. Required; the plugin throws on startup if unset.

project.description: W&B project name. Required; the plugin throws on startup if unset.

apiKey.description: W&B API key. String literal (discouraged), or a { source, provider, id } SecretRef resolved through OpenClaw's secret providers (env works out of the box; file/exec require a configured provider). Omit to let the plugin resolve credentials from WANDB_API_KEY or netrc.

serviceName.description: OTel service.name resource attribute, also shown in `/forge status`.

agentName.description: Override for gen_ai.agent.name. Falls back to harnessId/pluginId from events.

agentVersion.description: gen_ai.agent.version attribute. Leave unset to use the plugin package version, or set an explicit string (e.g. 'v0.1') to pin.

captureContent.description: Conversation content captured into spans. Defaults to false; set to true to send prompts, replies, and tool inputs and results to W&B. Captured content is not redacted by the plugin.

captureContent.label: Capture conversation content
captureContent.help: Off by default. Enable only if sending unredacted prompts, replies, and tool content to W&B is appropriate for this project.
